system.description:
FOCUS FLOURISH TECHNIQUE TELEPORTATION Action 1 AP

You can slip magically between spaces. This is a magical technique using the tradition of your Monastic Path. You instantaneously transport yourself to a location within your line of sight, covering a distance up to your Speed. You cannot take other creatures with you.

Automated: press Use: 1 AP (a Flourish), and this use. Move your token up to your Speed to a space you can see; the move is a teleport and provokes nothing.
